pr.title: fix(rte): wire strict batch response format
pr.body:
## Summary
- wire strict v5 structured-output response_format creation into the real run_extraction_v5 batch request construction path
- fail closed before upload/submission when strict batch request construction cannot resolve a valid json_schema response_format
- add offline regression tests using fake batch transport to prove strict request and wire payload behavior while preserving non-strict behavior

## Scope
- Repo Truth Extractor v5 batch request construction
- focused tests, task packet, proof, and implementer report
- no live extraction, provider/model calls, external batch jobs, sync path changes, promptsets, model routing, walker/prescan, docs sweep, dependencies, cockpit/TUI, or attestation writer rewrite

## Validation
- task packet/proof JSON validation and task packet schema validation
- compileall for services/repo-truth-extractor and src/dopemux
- focused v5 batch response_format tests, existing batch client tests, batch/strict subset, and operator safety tests
- git diff whitespace check and pre-commit on changed files
